correctness.rationale: Distinct Hamming open neighborhoods meet in at most two vertices for q=3,4; a descending-dimensional explicit elementary collapse eliminates all faces of dimension >=3. Counts of edges and higher faces give Euler characteristics 3^d(d-1)(d-2) and 4^(d-1)(9d^2-15d+8). Matsushita plus Behal-Chih establish the full parity-kernel groups; free H2 follows from the 2-dimensional integral chain complex. Seven exactly enumerated examples agree, including torsion.
